image_description: A group of people dressed in elaborate pink and blue costumes with headdresses are dancing around a central wooden pole. The pole is topped with a decorative finial and has multiple colorful ribbons (red, yellow, green, blue) extending from the top down to the dancers, who are holding them. The setting appears to be an outdoor sandy or gravel area with hills in the background.

All key geometric and functional checkpoints are present: the tall pole, colorful streamers, finial, and dancers weaving around it are clearly depicted.
